Docstring updated to explain `net_pnl > 0` is required by the C5 strict-greater-than check. With net_pnl=1.0: (a) C5 inline check at phase2_rule_pool.py:578 sees profitable=N, no shortfall, no penalty. (b) _symbol_robustness_penalty at phase2_rule_pool.py:264-285 sees pnl_pct=1.0/INITIAL_CAPITAL*100% which is well above PHASE2_SYMBOL_MEDIAN_RETURN_FLOOR_PCT=-0.5, so no median penalty; profitable=N meets effective_min_profitable_symbols(N), so no shortfall penalty. Net: support_penalty contribution from neutral metrics is now 0.0 in both penalty paths. Correct.
